advancedLoad.title: Advanced load profile
advancedLoad.scope: These are draft load settings. Apply & reload confirms the active model profile; saving an unloaded model sets its next load. Failed application retains the confirmed profile.
advancedLoad.inactive: Not applicable to the selected model or speculative mode.
advancedLoad.invalid: Value not saved. Check the range and ensure draft minimum does not exceed maximum. Enabled MTP requires a positive maximum.
advancedLoad.cacheHint: KV element format. Quantized caches require compatible head dimensions and backend support; quantized V requires Flash Attention. The effective format can differ after a safe fallback.
advancedLoad.cachePrecedence: An explicit K or V setting overrides the shared KV cache setting for that side only. Default inherits the shared setting independently.
advancedLoad.draftHint: Enabled MTP is required. Separate draft cache and GPU-layer settings also require a prepared draft-model companion. Self-MTP does not use those fields.
advancedLoad.draftVUnavailable: Quantized draft V is unavailable: this runtime exposes no separate draft Flash Attention policy. Use f16 or f32.

hints.ropeFreqBase: Frequency base; 0 uses model metadata. Applies to RoPE architectures.
hints.ropeFreqScale: Frequency scale factor; 0 uses model metadata. Overrides can affect long-context quality.
hints.noExtraBufts: Restricts extra backend buffer types; may change memory allocation and performance.
hints.swaFull: Allocate a full-size sliding-window attention cache; applies to SWA models and may increase memory use.
hints.nCpuMoe: Layer count for MoE experts kept on CPU. Only applies to mixture-of-experts models; 0 adds no CPU layer override.
hints.specDraftNMax: Maximum tokens proposed per speculative step.
hints.specDraftNMin: Minimum draft tokens required before attempting acceptance.
hints.specDraftPSplit: Split threshold, 0–1; support depends on the native speculative mode.
hints.specDraftNGpuLayers: Layer count; -1 requests all available draft layers. Actual placement depends on the admitted backend.

loraControls.title: Apply prepared LoRA adapters
loraControls.scope: Select up to 8 prepared adapters and a scale for each, then apply explicitly. Downloaded, selected and actually loaded are separate states. File preparation does not establish base-model compatibility; application verifies bytes and native compatibility.
loraControls.noAdapters: Bind and prepare an adapter below first.
loraControls.prepared: Prepared for this base variant; native compatibility is checked on apply.
loraControls.prepareFirst: Prepare this adapter for the current base variant before selecting it.
loraControls.scaleHint: Order {{order}} · scale factor −16 to 16. 0 retains the adapter at zero scale; remove it to release its allocation.
loraControls.invalidScale: Enter a finite scale from −16 to 16.
loraControls.unconfirmed: Native state is unavailable or changing. No applied configuration is claimed until the context is confirmed ready.
loraControls.applying: Applying adapter configuration; waiting for native completion…
loraControls.applied: Native configuration confirmed. The profile will be restored on normal reload.
loraControls.busy: The context is busy. Wait for generation or other native work to finish.
loraControls.memory: Not enough verified free memory to apply these adapters.
loraControls.failed: Adapter application failed or was cancelled. Check the confirmed state; reload if recovery is required.

advancedGeneration.prefillResult: Prefill completed: {{tokens}} prompt tokens, {{duration}} ms. No assistant reply was created.
advancedGeneration.title: Advanced generation
advancedGeneration.scope: Applies to the next request in this chat; no model reload. Blank numeric and list fields use defaults. Explicit 0, false and [] remain distinct.
advancedGeneration.inactive: Inactive with the selected sampler or reasoning settings.
advancedGeneration.invalid: Value not saved. Check the format, range or supported schema; the previous setting is still active.
advancedGeneration.stringListHint: JSON array of up to 32 nonempty strings, at most 256 characters each. Spaces are significant. [] disables the list; blank uses the default.
advancedGeneration.mirostatHint: Mirostat replaces the usual penalties, DRY, top-k, typical, top-p, min-p, top-n-sigma and XTC chain. Those settings are inactive while Mirostat is on. Tau and eta apply only while Mirostat is on.
advancedGeneration.probabilitiesHint: 0 disables token probabilities. They describe token likelihood, not answer correctness. Values above 0 cost memory and processing; temperature must be nonzero.
advancedGeneration.reasoningHint: Only active for models with reasoning support and reasoning enabled. Parsing depends on the model template.
advancedGeneration.thinkingMessageHint: Budget-end message for supported reasoning templates; up to 1,024 characters. Empty means no custom message.
advancedGeneration.ignoreEosHint: Off by default. On ignores end-of-sequence tokens; the response token limit still applies. Available only for Text output. Turn it off before using JSON or GBNF.
advancedGeneration.logitBiasHint: JSON array of up to 128 [token ID, logit offset] pairs. IDs are integers from 0 to 2147483647; the loaded model checks its vocabulary. Offsets are numbers from -100 to 100. No strings or booleans. The last duplicate ID wins; [] clears all offsets.
advancedGeneration.templateHint: Formatting is shared by context counting and generation. Overrides apply to requests, not the saved conversation text.
advancedGeneration.templateSourceHint: Local chat template, up to 32,768 characters. Blank uses the model template. Templates are data for the formatter, never JavaScript.
advancedGeneration.kwargsHint: JSON object with up to 32 named string, finite number or boolean values. No nested objects or arrays. Blank uses defaults; {} is an explicit empty object.
advancedGeneration.nowHint: Unix timestamp in seconds, 0 to 253402300799. Blank uses the current time once per prepared request.
advancedGeneration.prefillHint: Assistant prefill, up to 32,768 characters. Appended once to the formatted prompt and supplied as parser context. Spaces are preserved.
advancedGeneration.prefillActionHint: Evaluate up to 32,768 characters of unsent composer text with the current system prompt and template, with zero response tokens. Creates no assistant reply; requires an available loaded context.
advancedGeneration.inspectTokensHint: Inspect up to 16,384 characters of raw unsent composer text, with a detokenized preview limited to 4,096 tokens. Special and media tokens may not reproduce the original bytes.
advancedGeneration.outputHint: One output constraint is active at a time. A custom constraint takes priority over template grammar. Finished JSON is validated separately from generation.
advancedGeneration.schemaHint: Supported JSON Schema subset only, up to 32,768 characters and depth 16. Local references are checked; external references are rejected without network access.
advancedGeneration.grammarHint: GBNF text, up to 32,768 characters. The runtime checks grammar syntax; a generation error preserves the constraint.

hints.nProbs: Candidates per generated token; 0 disables probabilities.
hints.thinkingBudgetTokens: Tokens; 0 permits no additional thinking tokens. Blank uses the effort preset.

modelControls.kvCacheDescription: Controls KV cache precision. Lower precision reduces memory usage for longer contexts.
modelControls.liveSamplingDescription: These controls affect the next response immediately and do not require reloading the model.
modelControls.reasoningDescription: Controls how much thinking budget the model gets. Auto follows the model family when possible.

modelControls.reasoningRequired: This model is reasoning-first, so Off is not available and Auto keeps reasoning enabled by default. You can still change the level.

modelControls.topPDescription: Controls how wide the token pool stays before sampling.
modelControls.topKDescription: Keeps only the K most likely next tokens before sampling.
modelControls.minPDescription: Drops tokens that are too unlikely compared with the top candidate.
modelControls.repetitionPenaltyDescription: Discourages the model from repeating the same wording too often.
modelControls.maxTokensDescription: Caps response length for this model profile. Higher values can leave less room for chat history when context is tight.

legal.subtitle: How Pocket AI handles local inference, storage, and network access.
legal.introTitle: Pocket AI is designed for local-first usage.
legal.introDescription: The app keeps downloaded models, chats, presets, and settings on this device, while network access is limited to model discovery and download flows.
legal.onDeviceDescription: Chat prompts and generated responses stay local to the device when you use a downloaded GGUF model. Pocket AI does not call a hosted chat-completion API in the v1 release flow.
legal.networkDescription: Network requests are used for Hugging Face catalog search, optional metadata fetches, and model file downloads. If a model is already on the device, offline chats continue to work without that catalog access.
legal.storageDescription: Downloaded models, chat history, presets, and generation settings are persisted in app-managed local storage. Storage Manager can offload models, clear chats, and reset settings.
legal.downloadsDescription: Model files can be large. Pocket AI warns about low disk space, memory-fit risk, and cellular downloads, and verifies file integrity when checksum metadata is available.
legal.resourcesDescription: The app monitors RAM, disk pressure, and thermal state to warn about risky conditions and unload the active model when the device needs relief.
legal.controlsDescription: You can change language and theme, manage presets, unload the active model, delete downloaded files, and clear persisted conversations directly from the app.
